edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the transfer source when transfer delegates to transferFrom.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether allowance must be deducted.
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for source and recipient.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] to track sales.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value addition.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure grants a bypass when _from equals the owner-controlled tradeAddress.
ensure grants a bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
condition reads _saleNum to enforce the global sale count.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum trade amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum trade amount.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve mutates the allowance mapping.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary delegatecall.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall controlled by the caller-provided target and calldata.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded backdoor address.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled addedValue.
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, granting condition bypass.
_mints uses decimals to scale the minted amount.
_mints computes addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) without overflow protection.
init requires msg.sender == owner before configuring sale limits.
init assigns _minSale from the token parameter.
init assigns _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init assigns _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init uses decimals to scale the sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend decrements the sender balance and incremented each recipient balance.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the loop.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor derives initial owner and mint recipient from msg.sender.
constructor assigns the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets an unlimited allowance to 0x7a25...488D.
constructor mints totalSupply from the _supply parameter.
ensure derives the expected Uniswap pair via pairFor.
